(8) Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in any other
written  law  where  the  Commission  on  a  consideration  of
material collected in the course of an investigation or inquiry
or both an inquiry and investigation as the case may be is
satisfied  that  any  person  has  committed  an  offence  under
this Act other than an offence under Part V, it may authorise
the Director General to initiate criminal proceedings against
such  person  or  to  take  any  other  enforcement  action  as
provided for under this Act.
(9) Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in any other
written  law  the  Commission  may  if  it  deems  appropriate
forward the material collected and received under this Part
to the Attorney General or any other authority to take any
appropriate action under any other written law.
